findingDetails.title: The advisor document-frontmatter parser treats a prefix as a closing fence
findingDetails.evidence: parseDocFrontmatter finds the first newline followed by three dashes, so a content line such as ---not-a-fence can terminate the block and omit later keys or trigger phrases.
findingDetails.recommendation: Require the delimiter to occupy the complete line with LF, CRLF or end-of-input, and add prefix-collision and Windows-line-ending fixtures.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Compared current advisor parser with its focused tests and the strict whole-line delimiter in the spec-kit parser; no target writes.

adjudication.claim: A non-delimiter line beginning with three dashes can truncate advisor frontmatter parsing.
adjudication.counterevidenceSought: Checked valid block, inline list, no-fence, empty-phrase and path-sanitization tests plus the sibling whole-line parser.
adjudication.alternativeExplanation: The parser may intentionally accept a prefix delimiter for permissive Markdown; rejected because the sibling contract and YAML fence semantics require a complete delimiter line.
adjudication.downgradeTrigger: Document the prefix behavior as intentional and add a consumer contract proving truncated metadata is harmless.

findingDetails.title: Advisor-local shared-payload producer vocabulary has drifted from the canonical contract
findingDetails.evidence: The advisor copy accepts startup_brief and session_snapshot in addition to compact_merger, hook_cache and advisor, while the canonical spec-kit contract accepts only the latter three; the current advisor producer emits advisor only.
findingDetails.recommendation: Remove unused literals or explicitly mark them local-only, then add a cross-package parity test for the intended vocabulary and rejection behavior.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Compared both accepted unions and traced current advisor brief emission; no current extra-value producer was found and no target writes occurred.

adjudication.claim: Two preserved shared-payload copies expose incompatible producer vocabularies.
adjudication.counterevidenceSought: Traced current advisor output and compared the canonical validator's accepted producer values.
adjudication.alternativeExplanation: The extra advisor-local values may be intentionally private compatibility values; unresolved because no explicit local-only contract or parity test exists.
adjudication.downgradeTrigger: Add an explicit local-only schema boundary or demonstrate that both consumers intentionally accept different producers.
